scoring_justification: All quantities can be recomputed from the agent's submitted JSON files using the same formulas and public constants; comparison against paper-reported reference values with tolerance is straightforward.

outputs.description: Corrected nonlinear optical constant d36 (in ESU) for CDA and CD*A.
Temperature derivative of birefringence d(n2⁰ − n1⁰)/dT (in K⁻¹) for CDA and CD*A.

output_contract.notes: All necessary constants (refractive indices, crystal lengths, laser parameters, conversion efficiencies, temperature bandwidths, number of axial modes) are provided in the instruction or are standard physical constants. The agent performs the computations using the described formulas; the checker will compare the submitted values to hidden reference values derived from the same public inputs.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported d36 (corrected) for CDA and CD*A, birefringence derivatives, and the d36/d36(KDP) ratio.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: corrected value d36=0.96e-9 ESU; d(n2^o - n1^o)/dT = 8.0e-6 and 7.8e-6 °C⁻¹ (central values from central ΔT); ratio of 0.96e-9 to 1.04e-9 = 0.9230769.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's reported numbers and standard formula for birefringence (λ/(2.25 l ΔT)) using central ΔT = 3.4 °C and 4.5 °C, and the reference d36(KDP)=1.04e-9 ESU.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are exact or centrally reported quantities from the paper, used as ground truth for comparison.
